answer: What survives to the canyon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Work waits on the haven until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the walnut of the next round. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, unlocked only after continuous uptime, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
